items.author: laddingtongaz.bsky.social
items.context: YouTube reccomended me a video on the old arcade game Carnevil. A game I remember seeing the eye catch of when I was like 7 or 8 and I had nightmares for WEEKS. Seeing it now, yeah it looks dumb and silly, but I still have that feeling in my chest of like…that childhood fear feeling lmao.
items.text: That's such a vivid memory. Arcade attract screens were made to stick with you, and clearly this one did. Funny how it looks so different from this side.

Where are my retro gaming nerds? 😂 Amiga, DOS, Sierra, Ultima, Gold Box RPGs... all that glorious '80s/'90s shit. If you're into old games and computers, say hi and give me a follow. I'll check out your stuff too! What game got you hooked? #RetroGaming #Amiga
link card: Uggmugg's Retro PC Setup with iMac G3
items.text: Hi! Sierra adventures and the Gold Box RPGs are a great pile to dig through. A lot of those DOS classics are sold DRM-free on GOG with the old-PC setup already done, so they run on a modern machine without any tinkering.
